title.value: Inter-individual differences in cortical thickness and their genomic underpinnings in autism spectrum disorder
title.justification: The title accurately represents the focus of the paper, which investigates the association between differences in cortical thickness and genetic factors in individuals with autism spectrum disorder.
title.quote: Title: Inter-individual differences in cortical thickness and their genomic underpinnings in autism spectrum disorder

extractions.description: This paper explores the inter-individual differences in cortical thickness in individuals with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) and their genetic underpinnings. The study examines neurodevelopmental deviations and their molecular mechanisms within a large and diverse sample. Significant brain region differences and genetic correlations are identified, which influence ASD symptoms and risk. The findings highlight distinctive patterns of neurodevelopmental deviations and potential targets for therapeutic interventions.
